+---
+id: org.dxos.plugin.qa
+name: QaPlugin
+version: 0.1.0
+---
+
+A store for QA results. A `TestPlan` declares a set of `TestCase`s; each execution of the plan
+appends a `TestRun` to the plan's feed, carrying one `TestResult` per case together with the
+documents, screenshots and recordings that evidence it. Plans are authored and results are pushed
+by an agent over the DXOS MCP surface, so the same plan a human reads in Composer is the one a
+`flow QA-n` run reports against.
+
+## Extensions
+
+The following extension dialects are used in this document.
+Each extension is defined in the Appendix or resolved via its URI.
+
+| Term        | URI                            |
+|-------------|--------------------------------|
+| `type`      | `org.dxos.mdl.type@1.0`        |
+| `feat`      | `org.dxos.mdl.feat@1.0`        |
+| `test`      | `org.dxos.mdl.test@1.0`        |
+| `component` | `org.dxos.mdl.component@1.0`   |
+| `op`        | `org.dxos.mdl.op@1.1`          |
+| `skill`     | `org.dxos.mdl.skill@1.0`       |
+| `flow`      | `org.dxos.mdl.flow@1.0`        |
+| `step`      | `org.dxos.mdl.step@1.0`        |
+
+## Ontology
+
+Three ECHO objects and three inline structs. The split is deliberate:
+
+- **`TestCase` is an object** because a case outlives any one plan revision — results across
+  months of runs point at the same case, and coverage questions ("has QA-3 ever passed on main?")
+  are queries over that identity.
+- **`TestRun` is an object** because it is the feed entry: the plan owns a `Feed<TestRun>`, so a
+  run is appended, never mutated in place by a later run.
+- **`TestResult` is a struct nested in its run**, not an object. A result has no life outside the
+  run that produced it and is never referenced from elsewhere; making it an object would double
+  the object count per run for no query anyone asks.
+- **There is no artifact type.** An artifact is a `Ref` to whatever the artifact already is — a
+  `Document`, a `File`, a recording — plus a caption at the reference site.
+
+```
+TestPlan ──cases[]──▶ TestCase
+    └── feed ─▶ Feed<TestRun>
+                    TestRun ──plan──▶ TestPlan
+                        └── results[]  (TestResult)  ──case──▶ TestCase
+                                └── steps[] (TestStepResult)
+                                └── artifacts[] ──▶ Ref<Document | File | …>
+```
+
+## Types
+
+```mdl
+type TestResultStatus
+  desc: >
+    A terminal outcome — the only thing a case or a step can be reported as. `blocked` is distinct
+    from `failed`: nothing was tested, so it must not be counted as a defect.
+  literals: passed | failed | skipped | blocked
+```
+
+```mdl
+type TestStatus
+  desc: >
+    A run's status: any terminal outcome, or `running` while it is open. `running` is deliberately
+    absent from TestResultStatus — a case result that could be `running` would be counted as
+    non-failing by the rollup, and a run could seal as `passed` with nothing actually finished.
+  literals: TestResultStatus | running
+```
+
+```mdl
+type TestStep
+  desc: One move in a case — the authored instruction and its criterion. Mirrors `step` in the QA dialect.
+  fields:
+    id?: string                # stable handle; steps are otherwise numbered by position from 1
+    do: string                 # the human instruction
+    expect: string             # the criterion both a human and an agent judge
+```
+
+```mdl
+type TestCase
+  desc: >
+    The definition of one test. Stored with typename org.dxos.type.qa.test-case v0.1.0.
+    Static — an execution never writes here.
+  fields:
+    key: string                # stable human id, e.g. "QA-3"; unique within a plan
+    title: string
+    description?: string
+    steps: TestStep[]
+    tags?: string[]
+    source?: DXN               # the spec this case was authored from (a PLUGIN.mdl document)
+```
+
+```mdl
+type TestPlan
+  desc: >
+    Root ECHO object and the container the UI opens. Stored with typename
+    org.dxos.type.qa.test-plan v0.1.0.
+  fields:
+    name: string
+    description?: string
+    cases: Ref<TestCase>[]     # ordered; the plan owns the ordering, the case does not
+    feed: Ref<Feed<TestRun>>   # durable append-only log of executions (SetParent)
+    source?: DXN               # the `## QA` section this plan tracks, when generated from a spec
+```
+
+```mdl
+type TestTarget
+  desc: >
+    What a run was executed against. The field people filter on six months later, so it is
+    structured rather than prose.
+  fields:
+    ref?: string               # git sha, tag, or PR number
+    branch?: string
+    url?: string               # deployed app under test
+    env?: string               # "local" | "preview" | "prod" | free-form
+```
+
+```mdl
+type TestArtifactRef
+  desc: >
+    A reference to evidence. Not a type of its own — the target is whatever the artifact already
+    is (Document, File, recording), and only the caption and kind live here.
+  fields:
+    kind: screenshot | video | log | document | other
+    caption?: string
+    target: Ref<any>           # Document, File, …
+```
+
+```mdl
+type TestStepResult
+  desc: Per-step outcome within a TestResult. Positional — index n corresponds to TestCase.steps[n].
+  fields:
+    status: TestResultStatus
+    note?: string              # why it failed, or the constraint that blocked it
+    artifacts?: TestArtifactRef[]
+```
+
+```mdl
+type TestResult
+  desc: >
+    The outcome of one TestCase within one TestRun. An inline struct of TestRun.results — never
+    an object of its own.
+  fields:
+    case: Ref<TestCase>
+    status: TestResultStatus
+    steps?: TestStepResult[]
+    note?: string              # failure summary, or `blocked` reason (QA dialect Rule 9)
+    durationMs?: number
+    artifacts?: TestArtifactRef[]   # evidence for the case as a whole
+```
+
+```mdl
+type TestRun
+  desc: >
+    One execution of a plan, appended to TestPlan.feed. Stored with typename
+    org.dxos.type.qa.test-run v0.1.0. Results accumulate as the run proceeds; `status` is a
+    rollup, written when the run is finished.
+  fields:
+    plan: Ref<TestPlan>
+    status: TestStatus         # `running` until finished; then the rollup below
+    cases: string[]            # case keys the run set out to cover, captured at startRun
+    target?: TestTarget
+    runner?: string            # "human:alice" | "agent:claude" | CI job id

+version: 0.1.0

+  fields:

+    key: string                # stable human id, e.g. "QA-3"; unique within a plan

+```mdl
+type TestPlan

+  desc: >

+  fields:

+type TestRun

+## Features
+
+```mdl
+feat F-1: Author and maintain plans
+
+  req F-1.1: A TestPlan can be created empty, or generated from the `## QA` section of a
+    PLUGIN.mdl — each `flow QA-n` becoming a TestCase whose `key` is the flow id and whose steps
+    are the flow's `test` stage.

+    MCP edits a plan without touching ECHO directly.
+  req F-1.3: Re-generating a plan from an updated spec matches existing cases by `key` and updates
+    them in place, so historical results keep pointing at the same TestCase.

+  req F-2.1: Starting a run appends a TestRun with status `running` to the plan's feed and returns
+    its id; every later push names that id.
+  req F-2.2: A result is pushed per case, incrementally, so a long run is observable while it is
+    still going.

+    `startRun` — `failed` if any failed, else `blocked` if any is blocked, else `skipped` if any
+    case went unreported, else `passed` — and stamps `finishedAt`. A run that reported nothing
+    therefore seals as `skipped`, never `passed`.
+  req F-2.4: A run is immutable once finished; a correction is a new run, not an edit.

+    or stores bytes of its own.
+  req F-3.2: Artifacts attach at step granularity as well as case granularity.
+
+feat F-4: Read the history
+

+    pass/fail counts.
+  req F-4.2: A case surface shows that case's outcome across every run, so a flaky or long-broken
+    case is visible without opening runs one by one.

+    is what makes them reachable from `queryOperations` / `invokeOperation`.
+  req F-5.2: Every operation takes ids and plain values only — no live ECHO objects cross the MCP
+    boundary.

+    from writing it.
+```

+```mdl
+op createPlan
+  key: org.dxos.operation.qa.createPlan
+  desc: Creates a TestPlan with its feed. A factory — the caller places the object.
+  input:

+    description?: string
+    source?: string            # DXN of the spec document this plan tracks

+  effects: [echo:write]
+  requires: [Database.Service]
+```

+op upsertCase

+    on `key` rather than id is what makes re-generation from a spec non-destructive (F-1.3).

+  effects: [echo:write]
+```

+op removeCase

+  input:
+    planId: string
+    key: string
+  output: { removed: boolean }
+  effects: [echo:write]
+```
+
+```mdl
+op reorderCases
+  key: org.dxos.operation.qa.reorderCases
+  desc: Sets the plan's case ordering.
+  input:
+    planId: string
+    keys: string[]             # the full ordering; unknown or missing keys are an error
+  output: { plan: TestPlan }
+  errors:
+    UnknownCaseError: a key in the ordering is not in the plan
+  effects: [echo:write]
+```
+
+```mdl
+op startRun
+  key: org.dxos.operation.qa.startRun
+  desc: >
+    Appends a `running` TestRun to the plan's feed and returns its id. Captures the plan's case
+    keys onto the run, so a later edit to the plan cannot change what this run was measured
+    against. `cases` narrows that capture for a partial run.
+  input:
+    planId: string
+    cases?: string[]           # case keys to cover; defaults to the plan's full case list
+    target?: TestTarget
+    runner?: string
+    stages?: string[]
+  output: { runId: string, cases: string[] }
+  effects: [echo:write]
+```
+
+```mdl
+op pushResult
+  key: org.dxos.operation.qa.pushResult
+  desc: >
+    Appends (or replaces, by case key) one TestResult on a running run. Artifacts are given as
+    DXNs of objects that already exist.
+  input:
+    runId: string
+    caseKey: string
+    status: TestResultStatus
+    steps?: TestStepResult[]
+    note?: string
+    durationMs?: number
+    artifacts?: { kind: string, caption?: string, target: string }[]   # target is a DXN
+  output: { result: TestResult }
+  errors:
+    RunFinishedError: the run is already finished and is immutable
+    UnknownCaseError: caseKey is not in the run's plan
+  effects: [echo:write]
+```
+
+```mdl
+op finishRun
+  key: org.dxos.operation.qa.finishRun
+  desc: >
+    Rolls up `status` over the run's captured `cases`, stamps `finishedAt`, and seals the run.
+    A captured case with no result counts as `skipped`, so an empty or partial run cannot seal as
+    `passed`.
+  input:
+    runId: string
+    summary?: string
+  output: { run: TestRun, unreported: string[] }   # case keys that never received a result
+  errors:
+    RunFinishedError: the run is already sealed
+  effects: [echo:write]
+```
+
+```mdl
+op queryRuns
+  key: org.dxos.operation.qa.queryRuns
+  desc: Reads the plan's feed, newest-first, with optional filters. Results are summarised unless `full`.
+  input:
+    planId: string
+    limit?: number
+    status?: TestStatus
+    caseKey?: string           # runs containing a result for this case
+    full?: boolean             # include per-step detail and artifact refs
+  output: { runs: TestRun[] }
+  effects: []
+```
+
+```mdl
+op caseHistory
+  key: org.dxos.operation.qa.caseHistory
+  desc: One case's status across runs, newest-first — the query behind F-4.2.
+  input:
+    planId: string

+/**
+ * Read the convergence key an entity declares, if any.
+ *
+ * The convergence key is a caller-supplied domain identity, unique within a space: two entities
